milestone.title: raul: complete the review surface (tracks + backlog views M46 missed)

intent.outcome: raul covers the tracks and backlog human views that M41 dropped and M46 missed, so there is no human-readable gap vs pre-2.0 and reviewers stop piping mp list tracks/backlog --format json through external tools (or falling back to grepping plan TOML, a plan-zone violation).

problem.description: M41 made mp agent-only (only --format json/toml); M46 added raul inbox/validate/decision/execution to cover the human views M41 dropped and its AC-04 promised 'no human capability lost vs pre-2.0'. But M46 MISSED two surfaces: raul has no 'tracks' and no 'backlog' subcommand. Today there is no human-readable way to list tracks or backlog. Observed in the wild during the post-v2.0 review: 'mp list tracks --format json' was piped through python to get a flat one-line-per-track view, and when that parse failed the reviewer fell back to grepping master-plan/tracks/*.toml directly - a plan-zone violation. The same gap applies to backlog. M46 AC-04 is therefore technically still violated for tracks/backlog. While checking this, a secondary bug surfaced: 'mp list tracks --format toml' (and the other list commands) emit JSON instead of TOML - the list commands ignore the --format flag, so even the JSON/TOML contract is inconsistent for these reads.

in_scope: raul tracks: list pending/active tracks (one line each) + raul track show <id> for item detail, reading via the M44 shared reads layer.
raul backlog: list backlog items by priority, reading via the shared reads layer.
Extend crates/raul/src/reads.rs with list_tracks + list_backlog typed helpers (mirroring list_annotations).
Fix the --format dispatch bug: mp list tracks/backlog/ideas/decisions --format toml must emit TOML, not JSON (the list commands currently ignore the format flag).
Golden scenario covering raul tracks + raul backlog rendering, and the toml-format fix.
Update MP-COMMANDS.md / raul docs so the tracks/backlog surface is documented.
out_of_scope: A TUI view for tracks/backlog (CLI first; TUI is a later pass).
raul write paths for tracks/backlog (raul delegates every write to mp; reads only here).
New filtering/sorting beyond what mp list already exposes (mirror the existing filters).
